analogues_and_disanalogies.analogue: standard hypercubic lattice actions are exactly invariant under lattice automorphisms and can recover larger Euclidean symmetry only through a proved continuum-restoration argument
disanalogies: exact invariance under the finite hypercubic subgroup is not invariance under arbitrary O(4)
a continuum rotation of test functions is not automatically an action on link variables indexed by hypercubic bonds
local exponential decay does not by itself supply the missing a_k^4 normalization or define an off-lattice rotated gauge configuration
an O(4)-restoration estimate is an OS1 gluing lemma, not a mass-gap theorem

reject any repair that changes regulator, gauge quotient, observable family or continuum subsequence without an explicit same-theory comparison
